{{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=September 2023}} {{Infobox television season | bgcolor = #4B0609 | image = dwts8poster.jpg | caption = Promotional poster, featuring former pro dancer [[Edyta Śliwińska]] | module1 = {{Infobox reality competition season | host = {{Plainlist| * [[Tom Bergeron]] * [[Samantha Harris]] }} | judges = {{Plainlist| * [[Carrie Ann Inaba]] * [[Len Goodman]] * [[Bruno Tonioli]] }} | celebrity_winner = [[Shawn Johnson]] | professional_winner = [[Mark Ballas]] }} | num_episodes = 21 | network = [[American Broadcasting Company|ABC]] | first_aired = {{start date|2009|3|9}} | last_aired = {{end date|2009|5|19}} }} '''Season eight''' of ''[[Dancing with the Stars (American TV series)|Dancing with the Stars]]'' premiered on Monday, March 9, 2009, on the [[American Broadcasting Company|ABC]] network. The show generally followed the format of previous seasons, with thirteen couples, although there were some changes, including two new dances, the [[Argentine tango]] and [[Lindy Hop]], and an occasional dance-off between the bottom two couples, in order to determine who would be eliminated. Olympic gymnast [[Shawn Johnson]] and [[Mark Ballas]] were crowned the champions, while [[Gilles Marini]] and [[Cheryl Burke]] finished in second place, and [[Melissa Rycroft]] and [[Tony Dovolani]] finished third.{{Cite web |last=Barrett |first=Annie |title=Dancing with the Stars season finale recap: Shawn and Mark Flip Out |url=https://ew.com/recap/dancing-with-the-stars-recap-season-8-episode-21/ |access-date=2022-09-14 |website=EW.com |language=en |archive-date=September 14, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220914232356/https://ew.com/recap/dancing-with-the-stars-recap-season-8-episode-21/ |url-status=live }} ==Cast== ===Couples=== This season featured thirteen celebrity contestants. This season was originally advertised as the first American season where a husband and wife would compete against each other: rodeo champion [[Ty Murray]] and singer-songwriter [[Jewel Kilcher|Jewel]]. However, Jewel fractured both of her [[tibia]]e and was unable to compete.{{Cite web |last=theseat42f |date=2009-03-06 |title=Jewel And Nancy O'Dell Withdraw From Season 8 Of Dancing With The Stars {{!}} Seat42F |url=https://seat42f.com/jewel-and-nancy-odell-withdraw-from-season-8-of-dancing-with-the-stars/ |access-date=2022-09-14 |website=seat42f.com |language=en-US |archive-date=September 14, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220914214542/https://seat42f.com/jewel-and-nancy-odell-withdraw-from-season-8-of-dancing-with-the-stars/ |url-status=live }} She was replaced by [[Holly Madison]]. Murray chose to continue on the show, while Jewel appeared during the season as a special musical guest. [[Nancy O'Dell]], then co-host of ''[[Access Hollywood]]'', was also originally announced to be on the show, but was forced to withdraw from the competition due to a torn [[meniscus (anatomy)|meniscus]], which required surgery.
